name: Obsidian (mobile)
why_listed: Listeners who already keep a Markdown vault would record voice memos or type notes in Obsidian while listening elsewhere, instead of using Spoken Margins' anchored Margins.

platforms.value: iOS, iPadOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux (no web app)
platforms.detail: Native apps on all desktop and mobile platforms; files are local Markdown.

price_free_tier.value: Free: the full app, no sign-up, no limits
price_free_tier.detail: The app itself is free for personal and commercial use; Sync and Publish are optional paid services.

sources.title: Pricing - Obsidian
sources.quote: Free without limits. No sign-up required. No strings attached.

price_paid.value: Sync: USD 4/month billed annually or USD 5/month billed monthly
price_paid.detail: Optional Sync add-on (end-to-end encrypted, shared vaults). Publish is USD 8–10/site/month; Catalyst (USD 25 one-time) and Commercial (USD 50/user/year) are voluntary licences.

sources.title: Pricing - Obsidian

price_paid.note: US page, USD. Sync is not needed if the vault is in iCloud (App Store lists iCloud vaults).

voice_notes_anchored.note: Help pages read as Markdown source from Obsidian's official obsidian-help GitHub repo, which publishes help.obsidian.md. The help page says the plugin needs a microphone on 'your computer'; mobile support is not stated there.

text_notes_anchored.detail: Notes can link or embed a specific PDF page (#page=N); no core way to anchor a note to an audio timestamp or a text position in a web article.
